# descope_permission (Resource)

Manages a single custom permission in a Descope project. Permissions are referenced by name from `descope_role` resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the permission. Permission names must be unique in the project, and roles reference permissions by name. The names of the system permissions that are created in every project are reserved and cannot be used: `Impersonate`, `SSO Admin`, `Super User`, and `User Admin`.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this permission belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the permission.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
